custom_actions: Audit Vector: Inspect a nearby entity's movement path for legal compliance.
Recalibrate Mass: Adjust personal gravity to avoid or initiate spatial contact.
File Injunction: Temporarily freeze a target's movement pending a legal review.
social_rules: All spatial vectors must be registered with the Central Ledger before execution.
Accidental collisions require immediate submission of flight logs for arbitration.
Counterfeit gravity signatures are punishable by permanent mass-anchoring.
